resources.string: The balance is the cumulative sum of every transaction up to the end date of this period. Transactions dated later are not included.
Enter a negative amount to record a loan as a liability. Without \'-\' it is added to assets.
Enter a negative amount to record an overdraft as a liability. Without \'-\' it is added to assets.
Debit cards don\'t carry a balance of their own. Their spending is counted in the payment account, and the card shows only this month\'s spending.
The currency must be the same as the payment account\'s currency.
Changing the currency affects existing entries. The current exchange rate of the new currency is applied to all of them at once. Continue?
The difference is registered on your account details. Would you like to record the difference as an income?
The difference is registered on your account details. Would you like to record the difference as an expense?
Transfers into the selected accounts (savings, investments, loans, insurance…) are counted as expenses. Transfers out of them into regular accounts can be counted as income.
Count transfers from the selected accounts to regular accounts as income
Card spending can be counted when you use the card, or as one lump sum on the payment date.
